name: update_work_item
description: Update an existing work item: cancel duplicates, reassign to another agent, reparent under a container, or refine title/description. Prefer this over submit_intent when fixing task tree hygiene on an existing project.

status.description: New status. Use cancelled to retire duplicate tasks.

assignee_slug.description: Agent slug to assign, or null to clear.

parent_work_item_id.description: Parent container work item UUID, or null for root.
